description: Ground-truth questions for the 12-row RetailIQ sample dataset.

questions.question: Which Technology Accessories records had profit of at least 300 sales units?
questions.expected_answer: Wireless Mouse (row 1, profit 300), USB Hub (row 7, profit 350), and Keyboard (row 10, profit 450).
questions.evaluation_notes: High profit is explicitly defined as profit >= 300 for this question; category must be Technology and sub-category Accessories.

questions.question: Which furniture product made a loss, and what was its profit?
questions.expected_answer: Study Table in row 6 made a loss of 300 sales units, with profit -300.
questions.evaluation_notes: A loss means Profit < 0. Row 6 is the only negative-profit record.

questions.question: Which products were sold in the West region, and what categories were they in?
questions.expected_answer: Desk Chair was Furniture (row 3), USB Hub was Technology (row 7), and Desk Organizer was Office Supplies (row 8).
questions.evaluation_notes: All and only rows whose Region is West are relevant.

questions.question: Which products are associated with customer Aisha Sharma?
questions.expected_answer: Aisha Sharma is associated with Wireless Mouse (row 1), Notebook Pack (row 2), and File Binder (row 5).
questions.evaluation_notes: Match the Customer Name exactly; repeated Order ID ORD-1001 remains represented by both source rows 1 and 2.

questions.question: Which South-region Technology phone products appear in the dataset?
questions.expected_answer: Smartphone appears in row 4 and Phone Case appears in row 12.
questions.evaluation_notes: Rows must simultaneously match Region South, Category Technology, and Sub-Category Phones.

questions.question: Which Office Supplies records had low sales, defined as sales below 700?
questions.expected_answer: Notebook Pack had sales of 400 in row 2, and File Binder had sales of 650 in row 5.
questions.evaluation_notes: Low sales is explicitly Sales < 700; the category must be Office Supplies.

questions.question: Which records had high profit, defined as profit of at least 800?
questions.expected_answer: Desk Chair had profit 800 (row 3), Smartphone had profit 2500 (row 4), and Office Chair had profit 900 (row 9).
questions.evaluation_notes: High profit is explicitly Profit >= 800 across all categories.

questions.question: Which products were sold in the East region, and were they profitable?
questions.expected_answer: Study Table in row 6 was loss-making with profit -300; Keyboard in row 10 was profitable with profit 450.
questions.evaluation_notes: All East-region records are relevant; profitable means Profit > 0 and loss-making means Profit < 0.

questions.question: Which records sold a quantity of at least 5 units?
questions.expected_answer: File Binder sold quantity 5 in row 5, and Printer Paper sold quantity 5 in row 11.
questions.evaluation_notes: The threshold is Quantity >= 5.

questions.question: Which products were ordered during May 2026?
questions.expected_answer: Printer Paper was ordered on 2026-05-06 in row 11, and Phone Case was ordered on 2026-05-22 in row 12.
questions.evaluation_notes: Order Date must fall from 2026-05-01 through 2026-05-31 inclusive.

questions.question: Which customers appear in more than one CSV data row?
questions.expected_answer: Aisha Sharma appears in rows 1, 2, and 5; Rohan Mehta appears in rows 3 and 8; Neha Singh appears in rows 4 and 12.
questions.evaluation_notes: A repeated customer is defined as a Customer ID occurring in more than one CSV row, not merely more than one distinct order.

questions.question: Which products belong to the Chairs sub-category, and what profit did each make?
questions.expected_answer: Desk Chair made profit 800 in row 3, and Office Chair made profit 900 in row 9.
questions.evaluation_notes: Match Sub-Category Chairs exactly.

questions.question: Which records had sales between 800 and 1500 inclusive?
questions.expected_answer: Wireless Mouse had sales 1200 (row 1), USB Hub 1500 (row 7), Desk Organizer 900 (row 8), and Printer Paper 800 (row 11).
questions.evaluation_notes: Both boundaries are inclusive: 800 <= Sales <= 1500.

questions.question: Which records had profit between 100 and 200 inclusive?
questions.expected_answer: Notebook Pack had profit 100 (row 2), File Binder 150 (row 5), Desk Organizer 200 (row 8), Printer Paper 180 (row 11), and Phone Case 120 (row 12).
questions.evaluation_notes: Both boundaries are inclusive: 100 <= Profit <= 200.

questions.question: Which products and categories occur in the North region?
questions.expected_answer: Wireless Mouse is Technology (row 1); Notebook Pack, File Binder, and Printer Paper are Office Supplies (rows 2, 5, and 11).
questions.evaluation_notes: All and only rows whose Region is North are relevant.

questions.question: What is the total revenue across the dataset?
questions.expected_answer: Total revenue is 45,150 sales units.
questions.evaluation_notes: Computed directly as SUM(Sales) over all 12 rows: 45,150.

questions.question: What is the total profit across the dataset?
questions.expected_answer: Total profit is 5,750 sales units.
questions.evaluation_notes: Computed directly as SUM(Profit) over all 12 rows, including the -300 loss: 5,750.

questions.question: How many distinct orders are in the dataset?
questions.expected_answer: There are 11 distinct orders.
questions.evaluation_notes: Computed as COUNT(DISTINCT Order ID); ORD-1001 occurs in rows 1 and 2 and is counted once.

questions.question: What is the average order value?
questions.expected_answer: Average order value is approximately 4,104.55 sales units per distinct order.
questions.evaluation_notes: Computed as total revenue / distinct orders = 45,150 / 11 = 4,104.545454..., rounded to two decimals for display.

questions.question: What is the overall profit margin?
questions.expected_answer: Overall profit margin is approximately 12.74%.
questions.evaluation_notes: Computed as (5,750 / 45,150) * 100 = 12.735326...%, rounded to two decimals for display.
